intro: A Lost Master tasks an Alliance adventurer with gathering materials to aid in the search for Volcor, a night elf lost in the wilderness of Darkshore. Terenthis in Auberdine offers to weave an enchanted camouflage cloak to protect the rescuer, requiring pelts from the coast's fiercest moonstalkers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. Could I impose on you again to help Grimclaw and his master Volcor? In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by Darkshore's creatures while you look for him.

To create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near Ashenvale.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I can't in good conscience permit you to seek Volcor until I've crafted that cloak for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These will do nicely, friend. I shall set to work on the cloak immediately.
Give me a few moments, then return to me.

Oh, one more thing: after you've used the enchantment on the cloak you'll be limited in your interactions with others. If you can help it, do no more than speak to others. Much more than that could dispel the illusion.
